fields.name: ai_chatbot_availability
fields.short: Whether the article should be available for AI Chatbot (Fin).

fields.name: ai_copilot_availability
fields.short: Whether the article should be available for AI Copilot.

fields.name: ai_sales_agent_availability
fields.short: Whether the article should be available for AI Sales Agent.

fields.name: audience_ids
fields.short: The list of audience IDs to assign to this article for Fin AI Agent targeting.

fields.name: author_id
fields.short: The id of the author of the article.

fields.name: body
fields.short: The content of the article in HTML.

fields.name: body_markdown
fields.short: The content of the article in markdown.

fields.name: conversions
fields.short: The number of conversations started from the article.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The time when the article was created.

fields.name: created_by_id
fields.short: The ID of the teammate who created the article.

fields.name: default_locale
fields.short: The default locale of the help center.

fields.name: description
fields.short: The description of the article.

fields.name: draft_updated_at
fields.short: The time, in seconds, when the staged draft was last edited, or `null` when there is no staged draft.

fields.name: exclude_from_article_suggestions
fields.short: Whether the article is excluded from Fin AI Agent article suggestions.

fields.name: fin_involvements
fields.short: The number of conversations in which Fin AI Agent used this article, summed across all of the article's locales.

fields.name: fin_resolution_rate
fields.short: The percentage of Fin AI Agent involvements that resulted in a resolution (fin_resolutions / fin_involvements * 100).

fields.name: fin_resolutions
fields.short: The number of conversations Fin AI Agent resolved using this article, summed across all of the article's locales.

fields.name: happy_reaction_percentage
fields.short: The percentage of happy reactions the article has received against other types of reaction.

fields.name: has_unpublished_changes
fields.short: Whether the published article has unpublished changes staged as a draft on top of its live content.

fields.name: help_center_audience
fields.short: The audience that can view this article in the Help Center.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier for the article which is given by Intercom.

fields.name: neutral_reaction_percentage
fields.short: The percentage of neutral reactions the article has received against other types of reaction.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.short: The id of the article's parent collection or section.

fields.name: parent_ids
fields.short: The ids of the article's parent collections or sections.

fields.name: parent_type
fields.short: The type of parent, which can either be a `collection` or `section`.

fields.name: reactions
fields.short: The number of total reactions the article has received.

fields.name: sad_reaction_percentage
fields.short: The percentage of sad reactions the article has received against

fields.name: scheduled_publish_at
fields.short: ISO 8601 timestamp at which to schedule a future publish of the article.

fields.name: scheduled_unpublish_at
fields.short: ISO 8601 timestamp at which to schedule a future unpublish of the article.

fields.name: state
fields.short: Whether the article will be `published` or will be a `draft`.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: A list of tags objects associated with a conversation

fields.name: title
fields.short: The title of the article.For multilingual articles, this will be the title of the default language's content.

fields.name: translated_content
fields.short: The Translated Content of an Article.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of object - `article_statistics`.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.short: The time when the article was last updated.

fields.name: updated_by_id
fields.short: The ID of the teammate who last updated the article.

fields.name: url
fields.short: The URL of the article.

fields.name: views
fields.short: The number of total views the article has received.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.short: The id of the workspace which the article belongs to.

fields.name: admin_assignee_id
fields.short: The id of the admin assigned to the conversation.

fields.name: ai_agent
fields.short: Data related to AI Agent involvement in the conversation.

fields.name: ai_agent_participated
fields.short: Indicates whether the AI Agent participated in the conversation.

fields.name: attachment_urls
fields.short: A list of image URLs that will be added as attachments.

fields.name: body
fields.short: The content of the message.

fields.name: brand_id
fields.short: The unique identifier of the brand to associate with this conversation.

fields.name: channel
fields.short: The channel through which the conversation was initiated and its current channel.

fields.name: company
fields.short: The company associated with the conversation.

fields.name: company_id
fields.short: The ID of the company that the conversation is associated with.

fields.name: contacts
fields.short: The list of contacts (users or leads) involved in this conversation.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.short: The unique identifier (given by Intercom) for the conversation or customer ticket to link to the tracker ticket.

fields.name: conversation_parts
fields.short: A list of Conversation Part objects for each part message in the conversation.

fields.name: conversation_rating
fields.short: The Conversation Rating object which contains information on the rating and/or remark added by a Contact and the Admin assigned to the conversation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The time the conversation was created.

fields.name: custom_attributes
fields.short: An object containing the different custom attributes associated to the conversation as key-value pairs.

fields.name: external_references
fields.short: References linking this conversation to records in an external helpdesk or CRM system.

fields.name: first_contact_reply
fields.short: An object containing information on the first users message.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The id representing the conversation.

fields.name: linked_objects
fields.short: An object containing metadata about linked conversations and linked tickets.

fields.name: monitor_evaluations
fields.short: QA monitor evaluations that flagged this conversation.

fields.name: open
fields.short: Indicates whether a conversation is open (true) or closed (false).

fields.name: priority
fields.short: The priority level of the conversation.

fields.name: read
fields.short: Indicates whether a conversation has been read.

fields.name: sales_agent
fields.short: Data related to Sales Agent involvement in the conversation.

fields.name: sales_agent_participated
fields.short: Indicates whether the Sales Agent participated in the conversation.

fields.name: scorecards
fields.short: QA scorecard results for this conversation.

fields.name: sla_applied
fields.short: The SLA Applied object contains the details for which SLA has been applied to this conversation.

fields.name: snoozed_until
fields.short: If set this is the time in the future when this conversation will be marked as open.

fields.name: source
fields.short: The type of the conversation part that started this conversation.

fields.name: state
fields.short: Can be set to "open", "closed" or "snoozed".

fields.name: statistics
fields.short: A Statistics object containing all information required for reporting, with timestamps and calculated metrics.

fields.name: subject
fields.short: The title of the email.

fields.name: tags
fields.short: A list of tags objects associated with a conversation

fields.name: team_assignee_id
fields.short: The id of the team assigned to the conversation.

fields.name: teammates
fields.short: The list of teammates who participated in the conversation (wrote at least one conversation part).

fields.name: title
fields.short: The title given to the conversation.

fields.name: type
fields.short: Always conversation.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.short: The last time the conversation was updated.

fields.name: waiting_since
fields.short: The last time a Contact responded to an Admin.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The time the exception was created as a Unix timestamp.

fields.name: exception_date
fields.short: The date the exception applies to, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

fields.name: exception_type
fields.short: `closed` means the workspace is closed all day; `custom_hours` replaces the regular hours with `time_intervals`.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier for the office hours exception.

fields.name: name
fields.short: An optional name for the exception.

fields.name: office_hours_schedule_id
fields.short: The unique identifier for the schedule this exception belongs to.

fields.name: recurring_annually
fields.short: Whether the exception repeats every year on the same date.

fields.name: time_intervals
fields.short: The open intervals for the exception date.

fields.name: type
fields.short: The type of the object - always `office_hours_exception`.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.short: The time the exception was last updated as a Unix timestamp.

fields.name: category
fields.short: Category of the Ticket.

fields.name: contacts
fields.short: The list of contacts affected by a ticket.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The time the ticket was created as a UTC Unix timestamp.

fields.name: id
fields.short: The unique identifier for the ticket which is given by Intercom.

fields.name: is_shared
fields.short: Whether or not the ticket is shared with the customer.

fields.name: linked_objects
fields.short: An object containing metadata about linked conversations and linked tickets.

fields.name: open
fields.short: Whether or not the ticket is open.

fields.name: previous_ticket_state_id
fields.short: The ID of the previous ticket state from the most recent state change.

fields.name: skip_notifications
fields.short: Option to disable notifications when a Ticket is created.

fields.name: snoozed_until
fields.short: The time the ticket will be snoozed until as a UTC Unix timestamp.

fields.name: team_assignee_id
fields.short: The id representing the team assigned to the ticket.

fields.name: ticket_attributes
fields.short: An object containing the different attributes associated to the ticket as key-value pairs.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.short: The ID of the Ticket used in the Intercom Inbox and Messenger.

fields.name: ticket_parts
fields.short: A list of Ticket Part objects for each note and event in the ticket.

fields.name: ticket_state
fields.short: A ticket state, used to define the state of a ticket.

fields.name: ticket_state_id
fields.short: The ID of the ticket state associated with the ticket type.

fields.name: ticket_type
fields.short: A ticket type, used to define the data fields to be captured in a ticket.

fields.name: ticket_type_id
fields.short: The ID of the type of ticket you want to convert the conversation to

fields.name: type
fields.short: Always ticket

fields.name: updated_at
fields.short: The last time the ticket was updated as a UTC Unix timestamp.

fields.name: allow_multiple_values
fields.short: Whether the attribute allows multiple files to be attached to it (only applicable to file attributes)

fields.name: archived
fields.short: Whether the attribute should be archived and not shown during creation of the ticket (it will still be present on previously created tickets)

fields.name: data_type
fields.short: The data type of the attribute

fields.name: description
fields.short: The description of the attribute presented to the teammate or contact

fields.name: list_items
fields.short: A comma delimited list of items for the attribute value (only applicable to list attributes)

fields.name: multiline
fields.short: Whether the attribute allows multiple lines of text (only applicable to string attributes)

fields.name: name
fields.short: The name of the ticket type attribute

fields.name: required_to_create
fields.short: Whether the attribute is required to be filled in when teammates are creating the ticket in Inbox.

fields.name: required_to_create_for_contacts
fields.short: Whether the attribute is required to be filled in when contacts are creating the ticket in Messenger.

fields.name: visible_on_create
fields.short: Whether the attribute is visible to teammates when creating a ticket in Inbox.

fields.name: visible_to_contacts
fields.short: Whether the attribute is visible to contacts when creating a ticket in Messenger.
